Image 2 is the existing Ribbit anatomy guide ONLY for the simple frog-hand construction; do not copy its bare-body outfit or stance.
The extended OPEN GUARD HAND at SCREEN-RIGHT currently has four separate protruding rounded digits. Redraw ONLY that one hand with EXACTLY THREE visible rounded digits TOTAL, including the thumb: one shorter thumb lobe plus two longer rounded frog fingers. Remove the extra fourth finger while retaining the open guard gesture and wrist position. Keep the hand near the chest unchanged.

All other shapes and the whole original pose remain as close to image 1 as possible. Exactly one frog head, two arms, two hands, two legs and two boots. Entire character fully visible, turned SCREEN-RIGHT, without cropping any headwear, hand or sole. Retain genuine native RGBA transparency and clear margin around the complete silhouette. No background, floor, shadow, text, glow, halo, sticker edge, added prop or extra limb. Output one native transparent PNG.
